tree_0.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 0; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

tree_1.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 1; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

tree_2.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 2; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

tree_3.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 3; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

tree_4.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 4; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

tree_5.notes: Measured woody trunk and exposed root contact for tree variant 5; canopy and surrounding flowers remain passable. Mirror this UV contact with the same tree draw transform.

shrub_0.notes: Distinct shrub variant 0 woody root mass; outer foliage and painted blooms are excluded.

shrub_1.notes: Distinct shrub variant 1 woody root mass; outer foliage and painted blooms are excluded.

shrub_2.notes: Distinct shrub variant 2 woody root mass; outer foliage and painted blooms are excluded.

shrub_3.notes: Distinct shrub variant 3 woody root mass; outer foliage and painted blooms are excluded.

cabin.notes: House wall foundation and protruding front steps, traced independently of roof overhang and the decorative foliage. Frontmost step defines depth.

prop_0.notes: Standalone cabin sprite shares the measured cabin foundation; intentional duplicate of cabin, not a common box.

prop_1.notes: Three-log pile base following both exposed log ends and the diagonal rear timber; surrounding ground foliage excluded.

prop_2.notes: Long log pile variant measured separately from prop_1; oblique rear log and two rounded forward ends.

prop_3.notes: Barrel circular ground contact follows visible wooden lower hoop/base, ignoring upright body silhouette and plants.

prop_4.notes: Warm crate ground diamond; measured board base with bevelled irregular corners, separate from top surface.

prop_5.notes: Weathered crate has narrower tall perspective; individually traced base diamond and worn front corners.

bench.notes: Workbench ground footprint, legs and lower brace. Concave front edge follows gap between feet; excludes tools, tabletop overhang and plants.

stump_0.notes: Individual stump 0 exposed irregular wooden roots; passable moss/flowers omitted. Persistent solid contact after felling.

stump_1.notes: Individual stump 1 exposed irregular wooden roots; passable moss/flowers omitted. Persistent solid contact after felling.

ore_0.notes: Iron outcrop variant 0: separate large rock and foreground stone ground contacts, individually measured. Mineral paint is not collision geometry.

ore_1.notes: Iron outcrop variant 1: separate large rock and foreground stone ground contacts, individually measured. Mineral paint is not collision geometry.

ore_2.notes: Iron outcrop variant 2: separate large rock and foreground stone ground contacts, individually measured. Mineral paint is not collision geometry.

resource_branch_0.notes: Harvestable shrub variant 0: woody stem/branch contact only; the actual branch differs per image and mirror. Berry nodes use this same source shrub.

resource_branch_1.notes: Harvestable shrub variant 1: woody stem/branch contact only; the actual branch differs per image and mirror. Berry nodes use this same source shrub.

resource_branch_2.notes: Harvestable shrub variant 2: woody stem/branch contact only; the actual branch differs per image and mirror. Berry nodes use this same source shrub.

resource_rock_0.notes: Harvest rock variant 0, separately traced contacts for primary boulder and smaller stone; vegetation is passable.

resource_rock_1.notes: Harvest rock variant 1, separately traced contacts for primary boulder and smaller stone; vegetation is passable.

resource_rock_2.notes: Harvest rock variant 2, separately traced contacts for primary boulder and smaller stone; vegetation is passable.

resource_rope_0.notes: Soft fibre/reed clump variant 0, interaction footprint only; deliberately passable, not a blocking solid. Tall seed heads excluded.

resource_rope_1.notes: Soft fibre/reed clump variant 1, interaction footprint only; deliberately passable, not a blocking solid. Tall seed heads excluded.

resource_rope_2.notes: Soft fibre/reed clump variant 2, interaction footprint only; deliberately passable, not a blocking solid. Tall seed heads excluded.

resource_branch_spent_0.notes: Cut woody shrub remnant 0, smaller persistent contact traced on its actual depleted sprite.

resource_branch_spent_1.notes: Cut woody shrub remnant 1, smaller persistent contact traced on its actual depleted sprite.

resource_branch_spent_2.notes: Cut woody shrub remnant 2, smaller persistent contact traced on its actual depleted sprite.

resource_rock_spent_0.notes: Depleted rock remnant 0: each surviving individual stone gets its own irregular contact; gaps remain open.

resource_rock_spent_1.notes: Depleted rock remnant 1: each surviving individual stone gets its own irregular contact; gaps remain open.

resource_rock_spent_2.notes: Depleted rock remnant 2: each surviving individual stone gets its own irregular contact; gaps remain open.

resource_rope_spent_0.notes: Cut soft reed remnant 0: interaction/attachment contact only; stays passable after gathering.

resource_rope_spent_1.notes: Cut soft reed remnant 1: interaction/attachment contact only; stays passable after gathering.

resource_rope_spent_2.notes: Cut soft reed remnant 2: interaction/attachment contact only; stays passable after gathering.

gate.notes: Two individually traced stone post bases. Arch overhang and central opening are excluded from ground solids so passage remains open.

pond_0.notes: Water variant 0 shoreline traced from its own blue/teal color mask and constrained by its hand-measured shore behind reeds, closed across paint speckles and simplified by 0.0116 UV; excludes tall teal reeds, bank flowers and dry gray rocks. Not an ellipse.

pond_1.notes: Water variant 1 shoreline traced from its own blue/teal color mask and constrained by its hand-measured shore behind reeds, closed across paint speckles and simplified by 0.0153 UV; excludes tall teal reeds, bank flowers and dry gray rocks. Not an ellipse.

pond_2.notes: Water variant 2 shoreline traced from its own blue/teal color mask and constrained by its hand-measured shore behind reeds, closed across paint speckles and simplified by 0.0101 UV; excludes tall teal reeds, bank flowers and dry gray rocks. Not an ellipse.
